_comment: Empathize Talk about / Teach / Learn (NPCEmpathize.js SECTION 10, NPCEmpathizeLessons; NPCEmpathizeUI.js LESSONS). Pools are keyed by variant: default, em and bubba for lines Em or Bubba speak themselves, toEm and toBubba for an ordinary NPC answering one of them. Answer and reply pools are keyed again by stance: like, dislike, neutral, unknown. {topic}, {name}, {skill} and {price} are filled first, then the {a|b} alternation is resolved.
